values: KAIRO · business economics · hypotheses, not sales forecasts
Start with a 20–40 learner validation pilot. Commercial 250-seat cohorts and R49 subscriptions require buyer evidence, metering and delivery gates. No customers or revenue are claimed.

Decision: do not scale on enrolment statistics alone. Test a specific source → lesson → practice task, then a scoped paid offer. Annual upfront cash is NOT earned profit; deferred delivery still needs funding. All returns are pre-income-tax and pre-financing.

Model assumptions exclude free credits. Cash uses staged founder draw; operating includes replacement labour. Infrastructure reserve, demand and support minutes need real measurements. Scenario and 5,000-run stress results are in ECONOMICS.md / model-results.json, not live Excel forecasts.
